name: B10-0234/2025 (PfE) – Prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior, Tsi Conrad
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the prosecution of journalists in Cameroon, notably the cases of Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of five jailed journalists in Cameroon: Amadou Vamoulké, Kingsley Fomunyuy Njoka, Mancho Bibixy, Thomas Awah Junior and Tsi Conrad. It says Cameroon uses anti-terror and "false news" charges and military courts to silence the press. It asks the European Union and its member states to raise these cases with Cameroon's authorities and to visit detained journalists. The text is an opinion and a request; it does not change any law.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only asks for the journalists' release.
- It affects the five named journalists and Cameroon's government.
- Next, the EU and its member states are asked to raise these cases with Cameroon.
